narr: A strong winter storm starting in late December 2022 carried over into January 2023, bringing heavy rain and mountain snow to southern California.
ev: Flash flooding on College Avenue near SR76 reported by CalTrans. Full highway closure with disabled vehicles due to water up to 2.5 feet deep. Rainfall rates of 0.84 inch per hour occurred in the area, per observations from KCRQ ASOS.

Rainfall rates of 0.5 to 0.8 inches per hour were observed in this area between 4 and 5 PM. Total rainfall of 1.30 inches occurred just west of Cranston Station near Valle Vista at Blackburn Road and State Highway 74. Flooding occurred at this location around 2:30 PM as well.
